name: express-api
description: Express REST API (Node, ESM) with health + items routes and JSON body parsing.

files.content:
import express from 'express'
import cors from 'cors'
const app = express()
app.use(cors()); app.use(express.json())
const items = []
app.get('/health', (_,res)=>res.json({ok:true}))
app.get('/items', (_,res)=>res.json(items))
app.post('/items', (req,res)=>{ const it={id:items.length+1,...req.body}; items.push(it); res.status(201).json(it) })
const port = process.env.PORT||3000
app.listen(port, ()=>console.log('API on :'+port))
